component.name: ai-drudge-v2
component.description: AI DRUDGE V2: static AI news aggregator (build pipeline + single-page site on GitHub Pages)

properties.name: ai-drudge:sbom:not-covered
properties.value: the GitHub-hosted runner image (ubuntu-latest, unpinned) and the npm CLI bundled with Node.js

components.name: checkout
components.description: GitHub Action run by ci.yml, feed-audit.yml, refresh.yml

components.name: download-artifact
components.description: GitHub Action run by feed-audit.yml, refresh.yml

components.name: setup-node
components.description: GitHub Action run by ci.yml, feed-audit.yml, refresh.yml

components.name: upload-artifact
components.description: GitHub Action run by feed-audit.yml, refresh.yml

components.name: Node.js
components.description: CI runtime line (.node-version, read by actions/setup-node); package.json engines.node is ">=22.15.0". The exact patch release is whatever the runner installs.

services.name: GitHub Pages
services.description: Hosts the static site and its generated JSON. Readers' browsers talk to this origin only; nothing is sent back (bookmarks and settings stay in localStorage).

data.description: Site files and the generated edition (headlines, links, feed health).

services.name: GitHub Actions
services.description: Runs the scheduled data build, the gate, the site build and the Pages deployment (.github/workflows). Holds the optional ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret.

data.description: Repository contents in; Pages artifact, state snapshot on the data branch and failure issues out.

services.name: Anthropic Messages API
services.description: OPTIONAL. Writes the Daily Brief when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is configured; without a key (or on any failure) a deterministic brief is published instead. One request per data build.

data.description: Out: titles and summaries of already-public headlines. In: the brief text. No reader data exists to send.

services.name: Yahoo Finance chart API
services.description: Stock quotes for the ticker, fetched at build time. A failed symbol is published as an empty quote; the build never depends on it.

data.description: Public delayed quotes for eight symbols.

services.name: Google News RSS and link resolver
services.description: Query feeds listed in the source registry, and the resolver that turns Google News wrapper links into publisher links (results are cached in the pipeline state).

services.name: Hacker News search API
services.description: Points and comment counts of recent stories, used as an exact-URL ranking signal. Fail-soft: an error yields no signal.

services.name: Registry sources (feeds, listing pages, JSON APIs)
services.description: Every active source in scripts/registry is fetched with plain GET requests on each build; the hosts are not enumerated here - docs/SOURCES.md lists each one with its URL. Responses are untrusted input, parsed by the data-pipeline packages.
